title: Algebraic presentation of fixed-scalar sheaf inverse image
statement: Let C and D be small categories in a universe w, with Grothendieck topologies J and K. Let F:C→D be continuous from J to K and representably flat, and let A be a commutative ring in Type w. For L equal to the set-sheaf inverse image sheafPullback F (Type w) J K, there exists an AlgebraicInverseImageOfUniverses L (ring J A) (ring K A) [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image], with all six universes w, whose module functor fits into a natural isomorphism I.modules ⋙ restriction K A ≅ restriction J A ⋙ sheafPullback F (ModuleCat A) J K. Here ring and restriction are the normalized constant coefficient rings and scalar equivalences [lem-sfb-constant-scalar-restriction-tensor]. No module is assumed flat and no preservation of flatness is asserted.

source.place: Tag 03D2, lemma-pullback-module; Tag 03CY, lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules; Sites, Proposition 00YV, fixed-ring inverse image.

proof.text: Construct the coefficient homomorphism ring(J,A) to F_*ring(K,A) by the commutative-ring sheafification adjunction; it sends every constant scalar a to the same scalar a. Reuse constantComparison from ConstantLeftModuleTransport to identify the inverse image of the constant set sheaf with the target constant set sheaf. Naturality at PUnit to A normalizes this comparison on the sheafification units. Combining constantCommuteCompose with that comparison gives a ring unit presentation whose unit is the underlying coefficient homomorphism.

Use Mathlib SheafOfModules.pullback of the coefficient homomorphism as the module functor. The proved inverseImage_underlying_of_ring_presentation theorem gives its unit-normalized underlying abelian-sheaf comparison. Compose with sheafPullbackForgetIso for the abelian-group forgetful functor to obtain the required unit-normalized underlying set-sheaf comparison.

For each ring or module graph, form the target sheaf map given by the appropriate pointwise operation on the transported operand maps. Naturality follows from the ring or module restriction maps preserving the operation. Test equality of this map with transport of the source result map on the canonical inverse-image units, using hom_ext for unit presentations. The normalized unit comparisons reduce the checks to the coefficient homomorphism preserving addition, multiplication, zero and one, and the module adjunction unit preserving addition, zero and scalar multiplication. This fills all seven graph fields of AlgebraicInverseImage without separate product or terminal presentations.

At equal universes transport the specialized algebraic presentation to AlgebraicInverseImageOfUniverses by the canonical ULift.down and ULift.up sheaf isomorphisms. Reuse the proved private inverseImageUniverses converter from GeometricInverseImageExact; only this elementary converter is used, not its exactness theorem. The module functor is unchanged.

Compare scalar-restricted module pushforward with fixed-scalar sheaf pushforward by the identity on sections. Its A-linearity is exactly the coefficient homomorphism equation on constant scalars, together with the normalized constant-scalar restriction action. Conjugate this right-adjoint comparison by the two constant-scalar equivalences and apply uniqueness of left adjoints to their module and fixed-scalar pullback adjunctions. This gives the displayed natural isomorphism for the module functor. No flatness assertion or assumption is used.

proof_origin.note: R6: use the existing normalized ring-presentation module-adjunction theorem and Mathlib module pullback, prove all operation graphs by unit extensionality, and obtain the fixed-scalar comparison by uniqueness of left adjoints. No new unproved statements and no flatness theorem are used.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_constantScalarAlgebraicPullback
    {C D : Type w} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (K : GrothendieckTopology D)
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.IsContinuous J K] [RepresentablyFlat F]
    (A : Type w) [CommRing A] :
    ∃ I : SheafOfModules.AlgebraicInverseImageOfUniverses.{w, w, w, w, w, w}
        (sheafPullback F (Type w) J K) (ring J A) (ring K A),
      Nonempty (I.modules ⋙ restriction K A ≅
        restriction J A ⋙ sheafPullback F (ModuleCat.{w} A) J K)
